messages:
sam: Onboarding Tide customer's LoRA adapter (tide-lora@0.2) into staging. Quick plan: token-map check, 60-case invoice pack, int4 calibrated vs int8, and a short long-context accumulation probe. tagging @glee

glee: Uploading pack now: gs://redwood-evals/tide/invoice-mini-2026-03-24.tar.gz — includes 20 currency small-value cases and 15 long receipts.

sam: Running token diff first. Cmd: python tools/token_map_check.py --base open-7b --adapter tide-lora --out /tmp/tide-map.json

eval-bot: token-diff complete: remapped=6, oov=1 (INV# -> will remap to INVOICE#). Artifact: gs://redwood-evals/tide/tokenmap.json

nora: Note Tide uses micros (cents as ints). Watch for decimal scaling. Recommend baseline without soft-prefix then full adapter.

sam: Baseline (adapter w/o soft-prefix) queued. seed=11, base=open-7b@2026-03-14

eval-bot: baseline done: money-f1=0.979, numeric-mape=0.92%, p50lat +6ms. Queuing int4-calibrated (perchannel, calib=2048) and int8 for comparison.

glee: If int4 regresses on small cents, try perchannel-asymm + increase calib.

eval-bot: int4-calib results: money-f1=0.93, numeric-mape=2.1% — observed magnitude collapse on small-value cases (e.g., 0.10 -> 0.1 vs 0.10 formatting and occasional 10x magnitude error). int8: money-f1=0.98, numeric-mape=0.95%. report: http://ci.internal/reports/tide/job_12345/report.html

sam: Paste top failing example please.

eval-bot: Example A prompt: "Line: item qty 1 price_cents 10 Total?" baseline: "USD 0.10" int4: "USD 0.1" (formatting) Example B prompt: "3 items at 10 cents each" baseline: "USD 0.30" int4: "USD 0.03" (magnitude drop)

glee: Looks like scale collapse. Relaunch int4 with perchannel-asymm + calib=8192 and disable KV-cache on long receipts.

sam: Rerun queued (job_12346). Adding canary: tide-numeric-safe -> int8 if money-f1 < 0.95.

eval-bot: rerun complete: int4-highcalib (perchannel-asymm, calib=8192) money-f1=0.973, numeric-mape=1.0%. Long-thread diffs reduced. Artifacts archived.

sam: Conclusion: calibration + perchannel-asymm fixes majority. Will publish int8 and int4-highcalib artifacts and set canary. Opening ticket ENG-ML-5001 for adapter author to revisit soft-prefix scaling and token remap. Closing loop. :thumbsup:
